metadata.data_policy: Only information present in the CV materials is included. Unknown details are left empty or noted; no article titles or project details were invented.

details: Led and trained performance teams ranging from 15 to 150 participants, coordinating schedules, enforcing conduct standards, and ensuring readiness for live events.
Planned and executed cultural, institutional, and public programs requiring detailed coordination, real-time operational oversight, backstage supervision, and participant accountability.
Managed time-sensitive challenges during live events while maintaining morale, discipline, participant safety, inclusion, and collaboration.

event_leadership_creative_practice_youth.organization: Bangladesh Television and Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy
details: Selected as a national-level enlisted performing artist based on professional merit.
Performed within large production teams under strict schedules and live-broadcast conditions; collaborated with directors, producers, and technical teams.
Led hiking and recreational programs across Bangladesh, Nepal, and India, coordinating participants, logistics, itineraries, safety awareness, and on-site operations.
Conducted heritage study tours across Bangladesh for up to 100 students in historic cities, managing travel logistics, site schedules, group accountability, and supervision.

leadership_creative_roles: President, University Drama Club and Literary Club - directed stage productions, organized large-scale festivals and literary programs, and led creative student activities.
Pioneer Member, University Cultural Club - co-founded and helped organize campus-wide cultural events.
Host & Facilitator, Kishor Alo Youth Magazine - hosted youth festivals and large-scale events for one of Bangladesh’s prominent youth platforms.
Theatre Artist & Set Design Contributor - supported theatrical production planning, stage design, and creative direction.
Voice-over Artist - provided narration and voice-over for national television channels and media productions.
Film Making - directed short documentary and narrative films on heritage, cultural, urban, and social themes.
